items.text: "Wuod dhano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni piny Israel:
Giko osechopo e tunge piny duto angʼwen!
Abiro ngʼadonu bura kaluwore gi yoreu,
kendo abiro chulou kuom timbeu duto mamono.
bende ok abi weyou ma ok akumou.
Abiro chulou ma ok orem kuom wuodhu
Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.'
"Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho:
Nitie luoro maduongʼ, ewi gode, to ok mor.
Abiro ngʼadonu bura kaluwore gi yoreu
kendo abiro chulou kaluwore gi timbeu duto mamono.
bende ok abi weyou ma ok akumou.
Eka unungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye, ema akumou.
Onge ngʼama ibiro we kuom ji,
nikech mirimba ni kuom oganda duto.
Nikech wach mokor kuom oganda duto
kendo giik gik moko duto mag lweny,
to onge ngʼama biro dhi e lweny,
nikech mirimba ni kuom oganda duto.
to tuoche kod kech ni e mier.
to joma ni ei dala maduongʼ
Ginichur ka akuche modak ei holo,
" 'Gibiro wito fedha mag-gi e wangʼ yore,
kendo dhahabu mag-gi biro lokore nigi gima ogak.
e odiechiengʼ mar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye.
nikech gigo osemiyo gidonjo e richo.
Negidoko jongʼayi nikech ne gin gi kite ma nengogi tek,
kendo negitiyo kodgi kuom loso nyiseche manono.
Negitiyo kodgi kuom loso kido manono;
emomiyo abiro miyo gigi dokonegi gima ogak.
Abiro kawe mi achiwe ni jopinje mamoko kaka gik mope,
nachiwe ne joma timbegi mono modak e piny,
kendo jomecho biro dwanyo kara mageno.
nikech piny opongʼ gi remo mosechwer,
kendo dala maduongʼ opongʼ gi mahundu.
Abiro kelo piny ma timbene mono mogik
Abiro tieko ngʼayi mar joma roteke,
kendo ibiro dwanyo kuonde maler mag-gi.
to ginidwar kwe to ok giniyudi.
kendo weche mifwongʼo mabwogo ji nowinji kuonde duto.
Ginitem mondo giyud fweny moa kuom janabi,
gi puonj mag chike moa kuom jadolo,
wuod ruoth makawo loch kare chunye nonyosre,
kendo bede ji manie piny notetni.
Abiro tiyo kodgi kaluwore gi timbegi,
kendo abiro ngʼadonegi bura kaluwore gi chikegi.
Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.' "
